answer: Answers are salted with a 227 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Because the oasis salt is published after the jetty checkpoint, the orchard audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 87 keys hence pays for 87 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
